scope: N3 local research calibration and source-anchored shape-route comparison

calibration.model: f(age)=beta*age; within-identity centered least squares with total photo weight one per identity
calibration.projection: z=dot(neutral_raw_vertices,D)/dot(D,D), using the full verified mapped 199-PC direction
calibration.sign_policy: retain signed beta and all leave-one-identity-out slopes; never take absolute value or clamp to positive
calibration.same_age_only_identities: retain requested samples but exclude identities without distinct ages from slope estimation
calibration.failure_policy: retain failed requests, use successful fits only, do not impute
calibration.validation: leave one eligible identity out; training labels determine each fold coverage; flag held-out extrapolation separately
calibration.basis_observability: report projection of the full direction into the fitted first-40-PC span and its orthogonal remainder; do not replace the full direction

comparison.cohort: the three already observed exact-label real/generated matches from the N1/N2 report; no nearest-age substitution
comparison.reference: neutral real target fit, in the unchanged original full source canonical frame
comparison.primary_metric: identity-macro endpoint neutral vertex RMS residual to the real target fit
comparison.statistical_unit: identity; report all per-pair outcomes and identity bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20261020
comparison.truth_boundary: fitted geometry proxies, not measured 3D truth, age MAE, identity accuracy or future-face prediction

source_reset_and_bounds.reference: always recompute from the saved immutable original source, never accumulate edits
source_reset_and_bounds.reset: target equals known source age returns the exact original object and vertex bytes
source_reset_and_bounds.unknown: unknown source age rejects an absolute target; no default values
source_reset_and_bounds.bfm_nonzero_coverage: both source and target must lie within successful calibration label support; no extrapolation or strength clipping
source_reset_and_bounds.sam_nonzero_conditioning: existing exact integer source-label and target-condition fits only; fractional nonzero requests reject without rounding
source_reset_and_bounds.grid: for each of eight labeled successful bridge sources, test unique ages 20,45,70 and its source age; retain out-of-coverage failures

identity_change.method: actual edited neutral geometry distances to the real same-person target and different-person development photos at exactly the same label age
identity_change.margin: nearest different-person distance minus same-person distance, using the original source frame
identity_change.baseline: report no-change margin and each candidate margin change, displacement and pose/expression provenance
identity_change.limits: one available different-person exact-age control per matched case, uncontrolled pose/quality, same fitted basis; unvalidated geometry diagnostic only
identity_change.forbidden_claims: unchanged shape/expr metadata or unchanged age-orthogonal residual does not prove identity preservation

selection.scope: development-only research ranking, no formal evaluation or production enablement
selection.hard_gates: exact source reset, finite matching topology, fixed source frame and all three matched comparisons available
selection.bfm_sign_gate: full-fit beta and every leave-one-identity-out beta must be positive
selection.rule: choose the eligible candidate with the lowest primary macro residual only when it improves over no_change; otherwise static_fallback
selection.tie_policy: prefer no_change; relative tolerance 1e-12 and absolute tolerance 1e-15 are numerical equality checks, not quality thresholds
selection.holdout_policy: do not open evaluation_research_holdout age results or tune on it

permission_boundary: existing local noncommercial research registration only; no new downloads, training, redistribution or license changes
